v1.0.0-beta.3 SHIPPED 2026-05-07. Hot-fix for beta.2's bun-compile breakage; full validation passed (--version clean, data writes persist, MCP probe initialize+tools/list+tool call all work).

PATH TO v1.0.0 STABLE — Bun commit-phase complete + validated:
- Build: scripts/sea-build.js shells out to `bun build --compile`. Drops esbuild + postject. ~50% smaller binaries, ~50× faster builds.
- CI: setup-bun added; macOS x64 cross-compile no longer needs Node tarball download. Release-matrix wall time ~1m35s.
- Bun-compile runtime gotchas surfaced + fixed in beta.3 (see context.bunCompileGotchas): NODE_ENV=development at runtime, __dirname baked at compile time, argv[0]/argv[1] don't reflect invocation. All gated through a single bunfs-prefix check.

NEXT — STABLE CUT, USER-DRIVEN:
- Soak beta.3 for typical usage (a day or two). If nothing surfaces, tag v1.0.0 stable.
- Per project.soakPolicy: no formal exit gate for a release THIS focused, but a quick "did anything break in interactive use?" pass is wise before stable.

CARRY-FORWARD WORK:
- Issue #111 (zsh completions hyphen bug) — workaround in user's shellrc, source fix recipe in the issue. Could ride v1.0.0-beta.4 or v1.0.0 stable.
- Short-flag audit (per context.shortFlagAudit) — could ride beta.4 or be deferred.

DEFERRED to Reverie v1.1+ (unchanged):
- Test-runner swap (vitest → bun:test) — 2-4 days dominated by vi.mock auto-hoist restructuring across 31 files; per project.bunMigrationScope.
- Web app / visualization layer (mindmap, topology) — pairs with #83.
- Search improvements (#13 fzf, #43 boolean operators) — user-flagged in project.v115Hints.
- Entry health / staleness work (#84).
- Cross-machine telemetry aggregation.

SUPERSEDED RELEASES (don't run these binaries):
- v1.0.0-beta.2: data writes EACCES, MCP non-functional, banner spam. Anyone on this should `brew upgrade rvr-beta` to beta.3.
- v0.0.0-debug.0/.1: debug tags. Per context.releaseDebugTagSideEffects, the tap formula was overwritten by beta.2 then beta.3 — no remaining footprint.

DOGFOODING PART THREE: still expected, naturally pairs with v1.0.0 stable launch.
